parsed.reason: This message says exactly what is needed and why: "To send the introduction you agreed to, I need your name." It ties the ask directly to the introduction the parent consented to days ago, names plainly what is missing ("your name"), and explains the honest reason (the introduction email needs a way to greet them). The message stays under two short sentences, avoids any description of the other household, contains no padding, and does not re-introduce Hale or what it watches. It reads as a straightforward follow-up to an existing agreement rather than company boilerplate.
